name: Power Apps CLI (pa)
description: Installs the Microsoft Power Apps CLI (pa, npm @microsoft/power-apps-cli). Needs Node.js 22 or newer and a Secret Service keyring, which the keyring Feature provides. When version is 'latest', auto-updates on every container start via postStartCommand.

version.description: Version of @microsoft/power-apps-cli to install. Use 'latest' for auto-updates on each start.

github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: This dev container includes the Power Apps CLI (`pa`), which is pre-installed and available on the `PATH`. Run `pa --help` for the command reference and `pa auth status` to check the signed-in account.
